_about: Editorial counts and caps. Read by orchestrator/editorial.py and checked when loaded. newsletter.top_stories must match the count the selector and writer prompts state (agents/synthesis-selector.md, prompts/synthesis-pass2.md); a test holds them together.

length._about: The issue the writer is asked for and the eval scores against. 10,000-14,000 words with 6-12 items per section matches the issues before 2026-10-03 (12,600-14,600 words, 104-133 items). lead_story_words sizes each lead story, an original piece built from 3-5 findings; a single-finding Top story stays 300-500 words.

layout._about: The issue's layout, counted by orchestrator/issue_format.py after the writer and again after the editor, which gets every breach to fold into prose. Chosen 2026-10-10 after a replay came back with 117 bullets and three tables: Top stories are prose and may close on one short list of what to do; section items are prose; no tables; the sections in list_sections may be one list.

threads._about: Lead stories (orchestrator/threads.py). The thread_finder route reads all of today's findings and proposes up to `proposals` lead stories, each an angle several findings support together. Code keeps those with at least min_members findings not already published, from at least min_agents agents, one story per finding, strongest first, up to newsletter.top_stories. The selector fills any Top slot left. Earlier coverage is attached when a finding's embedding is at least `similarity` close to one from the last window_days and both name an entity that appears in at most max_entity_findings findings.
